mda_list.description: Ordered list of MDA binaries to attempt delivery with. sensible-mda checks for the first SUID MDA found in this list.

fallback_mda.description: The binary to use if none of the preferred MDAs in mda_list are found or executable. If this fails, delivery is bounced.

recipient_user.description: The system user under whom the local mail delivery process typically runs or checks for the MDA's existence context.
